That is a 35% gap - a promotion, not rounding - so RULE 22 makes the LIST price the cost basis and itemCostCad is 24.60, NOT 15.99. The DSers card for the same listing showed an API cost of US$11.34 (= the C$15.99 sale figure) and US$18.45 shipping; the sale figure is upside the model does not count. dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price.
verdict: Priced at CA$89.99, CA$4.61 over the CA$85.375 amazon.ca wall-sconce band median and CA$8.19 under the CA$98.18 RULE 2 ceiling. Contributes CA$20.72/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at the LIST cost of C$24.60 PLUS C$25.99 freight, against the CA$16.23 floor - clears by CA$4.49. This offer cannot take the pendants' CA$74.99 (contribution 7.75) or CA$79.99 (12.07); at CA$84.99 it clears by 17 cents, which is no margin at all, so it is priced at CA$89.99 - the same treatment as the tiered pendant and the nest, whose cost put the shared price out of reach. Rule 22: the page sells at C$15.99, a 35% gap under the C$24.60 originalPrice, so the list price is the cost basis. Freight is HALF the landed cost here: if the C$25.99 charge moves up by more than about C$4.50 the offer falls under the floor and comes off - re-read shipping before any paid push. Per-SKU stock 992 clears rule 4 (>= 25) by a wide margin. Voltage 90-260 V, E27, no bulb (the 'Including light bulb' SKU is the same price and was not chosen; the catalogue sells the fixture, not a bulb). Rule 18: the only other sconce in the catalogue is the plug-in swing-arm on COST_HOLD; this is a hardwired fixed-arm cone on a wood disc.

retailNote: Priced 2026-09-13 at CA$89.99, slightly ABOVE the CA$85.375 band median and CA$8.19 under the CA$98.18 ceiling. The live pendants sit just under their median because a reviewless store should not lead its band, and this offer would too if its cost allowed it - but C$24.60 list plus C$25.99 freight files 12.07 at CA$79.99 and 16.40 at CA$84.99, so CA$89.99 is the lowest x.99 that clears the floor with any margin (4.49). Same logic that put the tiered pendant and the nest at CA$84.99 instead of the shared CA$74.99.
